en.purpose: To calculate and assess the calculated value and risk group for the ELTS score.
en.misuse:
Not to be used for assessment of the ELTS score in patients under 18 years of age. 

Not to be used for patients with other myeloproliferative neoplasms.

other_details.en: The ELTS score is a further development of the EUTOS (European Treatment Outcome Study) score with an emphasis on long-term outcomes and the likelihood of CML patients dying from their underlying hematological disease.
